name: google-cloud
description: Google Cloud guidance for coding agents: first-project onboarding, authentication and credential selection, safety-critical validation for gcloud CLI commands, and the Cloud Operator Agent for designing, operating and troubleshooting infrastructure in your projects. Includes the Google Developer Knowledge MCP server for grounded, up-to-date Google Cloud documentation and the Autocloud MCP server.
suggestedPrompts: Help me set up a new Google Cloud project, link billing, and configure local authentication.
Configure Application Default Credentials (ADC) and IAM permissions for my local development environment.
Search official Google Cloud documentation using Developer Knowledge and validate my gcloud CLI commands.
